text:
alina: heads-up — eu-west1c just hit a weird repack loop, tiny jobs keep landing on mixed nodes and we're seeing a spike in evictions
ben: saw it, lots of 1-GPU short jobs arriving in bursts, scheduler keeps shuffling to make room
cheng: deploy-bot posted a rollout ~5m before the spike, might be coincidence
deploy-bot: deployment/online-inference v2 rolled at 1729987620 :rocket:
alina: quick triage — some newly provisioned nodes are missing the nvlink topology label (`nvidia-topo`) so our placement plugin treats them as incompatible later, triggering compactions
frank: that explains the churn. small pods land on nodes w/o nvlink, later a mixed gang needs nvlink and we evict the small pods to consolidate
infra-oncall: running a quick probe command:
```
kubectl get nodes -l cloud-region=eu-west1c -o=custom-columns=NODE:.metadata.name,TOPO:.metadata.labels.nvidia-topo --no-headers
```
infra-oncall: sample output:
```
node-18a  none
node-22b  nvlink
node-19c  nvlink
node-23d  none
```
ben: hypothesis: autoscaler rapid scale-up during a transient conntrack/net blip provisioned heterogeneous images, some without the nvlink-enabled driver config
cheng: mitigation options:
- short term: cordon & drain the label-mismatch nodes and reprovision with correct image
- medium: add scheduler filter so pods with `spec.annotations.prefer-nvlink` land only on `nvidia-topo=nvlink` nodes
- long term: alert on node label drift and autoscaler image drift
alina: running `kubectl cordon node-18a && kubectl drain node-18a --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data` now, will bounce into warmpool after eviction
frank: also turn off the descheduler canary we enabled yesterday, it's amplifying the compaction churn
infra-oncall: cordon/drain in progress, moving ~12 pods, ETA ~3m — tagging @cheng for scheduler tweak PR
cheng: will open a small PR to add a `prefer-nvlink` topology preference and a fallback grace window so we don't evict tiny jobs immediately
ben: can we also lower the aggressive pack threshold for tiny jobs (1-2m run) so they don't count for binpacking heuristics? saves churn and cost
alina: good call — lowering tiny-job packing weight in the scheduler config now, pushing change to canary
infra-oncall: added a short-term alert: `eviction_rate(eu-west1c) > 5/min AND node_label_mismatch(nvidia-topo)` to catch repeats
frank: ops playbook for this event:
1) cordon mismatched nodes
2) drain tiny pods into warmpool / reschedule
3) reprovision nodes with nvlink-enabled image
4) rollback/adjust descheduler
5) follow-up: add telemetry + scheduler safeguard
alina: filing infra ticket with logs and node list, assigning to infra team, will include `kubectl describe` dumps and the rollout window from deploy-bot
cheng: thanks — will also add unit test for the prefer-nvlink predicate and a slow-failback so mixed-gang jobs degrade gracefully
alina: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
